description: At the Vaalserberg tripoint a border stone marks where the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany meet, with three flagpoles and paths coming together on the wooded hill. The site is closed at midnight, so the scene does not invent a flag display or a crowd. It is clear and cool, about 12.4°C, with wind near 9.4 km/h. Sunset was 19:25. The viewing tower is only a distant shape, not the subject.
